text:
FOOTNOTES

1/ Of the monies appropriated in the Arizona exposition and state fair board lump sum appropriation, \$2,000,000 shall be spent for enhanced state fair operations. Pursuant to section 41-1252, Arizona Revised Statutes, before spending monies appropriated in the lump sum appropriation on capital projects, the board shall submit a report for review by the joint committee on capital review on the scope, purpose and estimated cost of the capital improvements. (General Appropriations Act footnote)

2/ General Appropriations Act funds are appropriated as a Lump Sum by Agency.

Operating Budget

The Baseline includes \$19,762,800 and 184 FTE Positions from the Arizona Exposition and State Fair Fund in FY 2027 for the operating budget. These amounts are unchanged from FY 2026.
